mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite the UNRATE crossing above 4.5%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and demand growth (GDPC1) creates conflicting signals, undermining market confidence and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases and GDPC1 increases in the same month
failure_condition: Rank IC exceeds 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or returns are positive despite the conflicting signals.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate (signaling monetary easing) compresses discount rates, enhancing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns fail to outperform baseline in easing periods, or the regime shifts before the signal activates.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in demand growth (GDPC1) reflects robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-positive despite sustained GDPC1 growth, or the effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 2017=100 baseline signals supply-side weakness, eroding corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above 100 when expected to decline, or returns are positive despite the supply shock.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in labor participation (PAYEMS) and demand growth (GDPC1) signals strong employment and economic expansion, boosting investor confidence and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises and GDPC1 rises in the same month
failure_condition: Returns fail to reflect the combined positive signals, or the effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime, simultaneous high FEDFUNDS rates and low industrial production (INDPRO) indicate restrictive monetary policy and weak supply chains, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns remain positive despite the combination of high FEDFUNDS and low INDPRO in the contraction regime, or the regime does not hold.
